text: APPROVE. The extracted `IsShebang` keeps the exact condition (`prefix == "#"`, bounds check, `line[index + 1] == '!'`) and `? -1 : i` preserves both return values, so behaviour is unchanged. Removing the nested `if` and its `&&` chain should drop the complexity from 16 to about 14, and the new private static helper with a doc comment should not introduce any warnings.
